name: @ptahjs/tri-devtools
description: Inspect @ptahjs/tri in real time: scenes, store, entities, systems, and renderer config. For tri engine developers.

scripts.zip: node -e "const {execSync} = require('child_process'); const fs = require('fs'); const v = require('./package.json').version; fs.mkdirSync('dist', {recursive: true}); execSync(`bestzip ../../dist/ptahjs-devtools-v${v}.zip *`, {stdio: 'inherit', cwd: 'src/browser-extension'})"
scripts.sign: dotenv -e .env -- web-ext sign --source-dir src/browser-extension --artifacts-dir dist --channel unlisted
scripts.sign:listed: dotenv -e .env -- web-ext sign --source-dir src/browser-extension --artifacts-dir dist --channel listed --amo-metadata amo-metadata.json
